title: I'm making a bullet-hell where you only get one shot… and you have to recall it
author: summercomet_
selftext:
Made with Opus 5.5 and Three.js

Inkscape was used for the graphics.

It plays like a regular shoot'em up, but your shot act more like a golf ball... and you need to bring it back after each shot.

There are power-ups to add variety to the gameplay, like a large explosion when bouncing of screen border, one that makes your tether a laser that deals damage, and an explosion when interrupting recall.

The visuals and UI still need to be reworked a bit, but the core gameplay is here (I'm planning to make 2 levels)
